name: Ambient Weather Display
author: Jimson Circle of Lights
description: Shows the live temperature and wind speed from your Ambient Weather station on a Pixel Overlay Model (LED matrix): scrolling or centered text in one color or many (per letter, rainbow, gradients), or inside a striped Christmas border. Settings page with Save & Show Now; run it from playlists or the scheduler with Run Script > AmbientWeather.sh. Each update asks Ambient Weather's server (rt.ambientweather.net) for your station's readings using your own API keys; nothing else is sent. Border pictures are written to FPP's images folder as ambient_weather_*.png and cleaned up automatically.

privacy.summary: Gets your weather station's latest readings from Ambient Weather using your own API keys. Sends nothing else.

sends.what: Your Ambient Weather API keys, to read your own station's latest readings
sends.why: to show your station's weather on the matrix

systemChanges.what: Adds AmbientWeather.sh to FPP's Scripts folder (removed on uninstall)

privacy.other: The plugin author keeps no data. Your keys stay on your FPP, in plugindata (readable only by FPP's user). Uninstall removes them, the script, pictures and log.
